title: Structure-aware chunking
goal: Chunk a small contract-shaped document by headings, pages, and block type, and keep summaries extractive.
method: Headings and page markers split the document. Each chunk stores doc id, version hash, page, section path, offsets, and chunk type. Summaries are the highest-salience sentences already in the chunk.

metrics.sample_summary: Ravi Sharma (the Lessee) residing at 14 MG Road, Pune 411001. ABC Pvt Ltd (the Lessor) having its office at 48 Park Street, Kolkata 700016.

results_prose: The sample document produced 5 chunks with types {'party_block': 1, 'definition': 1, 'clause': 1, 'schedule': 1, 'signature': 1}. Missing expected types: none. All chunks share one version hash: True. Extractive summaries are substrings and are marked not evidence: True. A 80-sentence obligation block split into 19 chunks (max 50 words) with 18 adjacent overlapping pairs. Pages seen: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].
conclusion: Chunk metadata and extractive summaries behave as specified on this sample. The word-window settings used here are smaller than the 200 to 400 token production window so the sample still splits.
scale_down: One short document plus one generated long clause. Token counts are whitespace words, not a model tokenizer. Production target of 200 to 400 tokens was not the setting for the short sample.
